play_mode_notes: SetPlayMode(PlayMode) is case-insensitive; any other/empty value -> NORMAL (Linux MiyueQueue.cpp:621-638; Android UpnpNativeBridge.java:692-709). GetPlayMode returns exactly one of the four (Linux 641-650). Device mapping: NORMAL=顺序(3) REPEAT_ALL=列表循环(0) REPEAT_ONE=1 SHUFFLE=2.

LIVE: NORMAL/REPEAT_ONE/SHUFFLE/REPEAT_ALL each read back identically; 'repeat_one' -> REPEAT_ONE; 'FOO' and '' -> NORMAL. AVTransport.SetPlayMode(NewPlayMode=REPEAT_ALL) also maps into the same state (Android). Restored to REPEAT_ALL.

select_source.music_semantics: 'Music' (and 'Off' / anything unrecognised) = close all external inputs and return to the local player: Linux MiyueAudioSource.cpp:133-146 (switchBluetooth(false) if BT on, stop SPDIF and setCurPlaySource(FFMPEG)); Android CommandService.java:1293-1310 -> switchSource('Music', false) (1279-1289: stops AUX/SPDIF capture only, Bluetooth left alone). It does NOT resume the queue by itself - send AVTransport.Play/SeekToTrack afterwards if playback is wanted.
notes: SPDIF/Coaxial and Bluetooth/BT are case-insensitive synonyms (Linux 118-130; Android 1256, 1276). AUX is a no-op on M100 (no hardware).
Selecting SPDIF/AUX on Android pauses the local music (CommandService.java:1262-1264); on Linux it leaves the sync group first (stopSyncGroup).
Linux MiyueAudioSource.cpp:158: on = (onStr == "1" || iequals(onStr,"true")). Android UpnpNativeBridge.java:506: "1".equals(on) || "true".equalsIgnoreCase(on). Everything else is OFF. Send "1"/"0".

LIVE: SetInputOpen(SPDIF,'1') -> within 1.2 s GetExternalInputs OpenSpdif=1, TransportState PLAYING, GetQueue.CurrentIndex -103. SetInputOpen(SPDIF,'0'), 'false', SelectSource(Music) each returned 200 but OpenSpdif still read 1 for the next ~20 s (Android dispatches through an EventBus background thread and AuxSpdifManager.restart/stop are synchronous native calls; rapid toggles queue up). ~30 s later OpenSpdif read 0 without further commands. Driver: send once, then poll GetExternalInputs (up to ~10 s) rather than re-sending; do not toggle rapidly.

After SPDIF closed, TransportState stayed PLAYING and CurrentIndex -103 until a queue command (SeekToTrack) reclaimed the local player, which then reported PAUSED_PLAYBACK. So 'SPDIF off' does not restore the previous local playback state.
SetInputOpen(AUX, ...) on a WithAux=0 device -> 200, no effect.

play_tts.android: UpnpManager.cpp:2017-2026 -> UpnpNativeBridge.java:434-451 -> TtsManager.speakCommand (TtsManager.java:123-196): Volume parsed as int; applied only if > 0 (empty/0/invalid = keep current); snapshot of stream volume + playing state taken before, music paused, and on completion the ORIGINAL volume is restored and playback resumed/paused as before. Rejected (returns false, still HTTP 200) if a command TTS is already in flight.
play_tts.linux: MiyueSystem.cpp:60-71 + :250-256 -> MYTTSPlayer::playDirect (MYTTSPlayer.cpp:206-268): invalid/<=0 volume = keep current (236-239); saved volume restored unconditionally at the end (264-268). NOTE the HA CONTRACT.md documents older Linux builds muting on empty/0 volume and never restoring - so the driver must always send Volume in 1..100.
play_tts.live: 192.168.1.47 paused, volume 0: PlayTTS('测试', 20) -> 200 in 34 ms; GetVolume read 20 from +0.4 s to +1.1 s, back to 0 at +1.5 s; GetTransportInfo reported PLAYING during the announcement. PlayTTS('测试二', '') -> volume stayed 0, state PLAYING for ~1.5 s then PAUSED_PLAYBACK. Empty Volume and missing Volume arg both accepted (200).
notes: TTS makes TransportState flip to PLAYING briefly - the poller should not treat that as a user play. PlayTTS is per device (no group fan-out).

rendering_control.slave_behavior: Current firmware of both generations ALWAYS embeds the MediaRenderer regardless of Master/Slave role (Android UpnpManager.cpp:850-864; Linux UpnpManager.cpp:133-146), so RenderingControl/AVTransport answer on a slave. Older builds omitted the MediaRenderer on a Slave -> HTTP 404 on /MediaRenderer/* (documented in haplugin/docs/CONTRACT.md). Keep the 404 tolerance (skip volume/mute, retry later). Slave devices reject third-party SetAVTransportURI with 705 (Linux DlnaController.cpp:203-208). Not testable live: 192.168.1.47 is Role None.
rendering_control.events: SetVolume/SetMute emit RCS LastChange; the driver polls instead.

description.url: http://<ip>:<port>/description.xml (port starts at 49495 and may drift; URLBase element carries the real base)
description.android_vs_linux_discriminator: MiyueUpdate is present on the Android .47 build and absent on the Linux .170 build (matches HA CONTRACT.md), BUT the Linux source tree also ships MiyueUpdate.cpp and its comment says MiyueUpdate is meant to be Linux-only in future builds - so do not rely on it alone. Robust: Linux inlines <miyue:role>/<miyue:groupID> in description.xml and lists GetTimeline in the MiyueQueue SCPD (Android does not); GetDeviceInfo Manufacturer is 'MiYue' (Android) vs 'MiYue Intelligent Electronics Co., Ltd.' (Linux); Android lists AVTransport Next/Previous/SetPlayMode in its SCPD, Linux does not.
description.soap_fault_shape: HTTP 500 + <s:Fault><detail><UPnPError><errorCode>N</errorCode><errorDescription>..</errorDescription>. Unknown action: Android -> 501 'Action Failed' (pupnp rewrites), Linux -> 401 'Invalid Action'. Treat both as 'unsupported'.
description.response_shape: <u:XResponse xmlns:u="<serviceType>"> with plain child elements; actions without out args return an empty <u:XResponse/>.

quirks: All queue indices are 0-based: AppendQueue.InsertAt, ReplaceQueue.StartingIndex, SeekToTrack.Index, RemoveTrack.Index, GetQueue.StartIndex/CurrentIndex.

Queue/library write actions return 200 synchronously but apply asynchronously (Linux MYMAINLOOP.post, Android runOnMainBlocking/EventBus): re-read GetQueue / GetCollected* after ~500-800 ms; poll GetTransportInfo for PLAYING for up to 6 s after ReplaceQueue/SeekToTrack/Play (observed 0.85-1.1 s).

AVTransport.Stop on Android reports PAUSED_PLAYBACK afterwards (not STOPPED) for the local queue; position/metadata retained. Map STOPPED/NO_MEDIA_PRESENT/PAUSED_PLAYBACK all to PAUSE as the spec says.

GetPositionInfo.TrackURI on Android may read 'airplay://current' even while the local queue is playing (stale label) - never infer the owner from TrackURI; use GetQueue.CurrentIndex sign and GetExternalInputs.
GetPositionInfo keeps the last track's TrackMetaData/TrackDuration/RelTime when the queue is empty or stopped (stale now-playing); clear the now-playing UI when GetQueue.Total==0.
Unplayable tracks (e.g. Qobuz songSrc 25 without account) make the player error-skip: CurrentIndex advances by 1-2 per command and PLAYING is never reached. Always resync from GetQueue.
TTS flips TransportState to PLAYING for the announcement and briefly changes GetVolume (Android restores in ~1.5 s).

AVTransport Next/Previous: listed in the Android SCPD and work (route by owner; LIVE Next 1->2, Previous 2->1). On Linux they are NOT in the SCPD but the handler exists and acts (DlnaController.cpp:386-404 dispatchButton) - Upnp.has() will say false there, so SeekToTrack((idx+delta) mod total) remains the portable path.
MiyueQueue.GetTimeline is Linux-only (Android .47 -> 501). GetHistory exists on both.

Empty DIDL results are a self-closing container '<DIDL-Lite xmlns="urn:schemas-upnp-org:metadata-1-0/DIDL-Lite/"/>' (GetCollectedRadios/GetSonglistTracks bad id/GetQueue empty on Android) - the DIDL parser must return {} for it.

Item ids: local tracks id = 32-hex songId (path md5) with <miyue:musicId> = db row id, songSrc 0, empty <res> (duration attr only), albumArtURI empty or http://<ip>:18181/...; online tracks numeric ids; collected items carry <miyue:musicId> needed for removal.

Local ID3 titles can be GBK bytes served as Latin-1 mojibake (LIVE: 'Õ¾³¤ËØ²Ä(sc.chinaz.com)' = 站长素材). Pass through unchanged (Control4 shows garbage but keys still match); do not attempt re-decoding in Lua.
DIDL <res duration> uses unpadded hours 'h:mm:ss' (Linux MiyueLibrary.cpp:86-95); AVTransport RelTime/TrackDuration use 'HH:MM:SS'. Didl.timeToMs must accept both.
SetVolume with a non-numeric DesiredVolume sets volume 0 (atoi). Always send integers.
AddTrackToSonglist does not dedupe local tracks on Android -> duplicate rows; check before collecting. IsTrackCollected is unreliable on Android (returned 0 for a collected netease songId).
GetCollectedBoards/GetCollectedSonglists JSON objects contain id as a STRING ('"id":"4"') plus boardId/boardSrc/icon/count; icon may be empty -> use default icon.

SelectSource/SetInputOpen are asynchronous on Android and can lag by tens of seconds after rapid toggles; after SPDIF off, transport stays PLAYING with CurrentIndex -103 until a queue command reclaims local playback.
AppendQueue of a radio item is dropped on Linux; ReplaceQueue of a radio plays it as an overlay (queue preserved, CurrentIndex -100).
Slave renderers: current firmware always exposes MediaRenderer; older firmware 404s on /MediaRenderer/* - keep tolerant. Slaves also reject foreign SetAVTransportURI with 705.
HTTP port can drift from 49495 after reboots (pupnp FD leaks) - probe 49495..49520 and read URLBase.

During probing 192.168.1.47's transport reported PAUSED_PLAYBACK while its queue index sat on unplayable Qobuz tracks; final restored state: queue 53 tracks identical ids, PAUSED_PLAYBACK, volume 0, mute 0, REPEAT_ALL, SPDIF closed, collections identical; CurrentIndex ended at 6 (was 2) because every SeekToTrack(2) attempt churned forward on the unplayable tracks.
